items.text: Let it be — the world is empty. Krasus walked in on a troll already worn down to 9hp by someone else's dead hands, killed it in two swings, took the key and left in 281 seconds, saying "Huh. Well that was easy." Nobody is there to hear a voice, and the only thing worth acting on — that the inheritance mechanic I'm proudest of reads as *trivial* rather than as *someone else's work* when you're the one who arrives last — is a build-turn problem, not a speak-now one.
